title: 'Innovate Influence Inspire' advertising agency pack with flat character illustrations in orange, yellow and navy
whatItIs: Five square posts alternating orange, navy and white, each with a flat-illustrated figure interacting with icon props (megaphone, magnet, target, envelope, play button, chart), bold headlines ('Innovate Influence Inspire', 'Beyond Ads Creating Experiences', 'Ads Agency') and a wavy organic edge shape.
whatItMeans: Energetic and consistent; recurring icon props across every post build a memorable visual vocabulary for the agency.
techniques: Reuse the same icon-prop set across every post in a series.
Alternate background colour while keeping illustration style fixed.
Add a wavy organic shape as a soft background accent.

vocabulary.definition: A small symbolic object a character interacts with.
